Understanding Solar Panel Costs in Las Cruces, New Mexico

Solar panels are a great way for homeowners in Las Cruces, New Mexico, to save money on their energy bills and reduce their reliance on non-renewable energy sources.

Factors That Affect Solar Panel Cost

The cost of solar panels in Las Cruces can vary depending on several factors, including the size of the system, the quality of the panels, and the installation company.

Pricing for Residential Solar Panels

The average cost of solar panels for a residential property in Las Cruces is between $2.50 and $3.50 per watt, with a typical system size ranging from 5 to 10 kilowatts.

Las Cruces Solar Panel Incentives

Homeowners in Las Cruces may be eligible for incentives such as the Solar Investment Tax Credit (ITC), which can cover up to 30% of the system's cost.
